outcome.Summary: Fixed the deadlock in `bank.Transfer` by locking the two accounts in a global ID order (plus a new bank-level mutex acquired before the account locks, keeping one consistent lock order), and restored/kept all original error paths (ErrBadAmount, ErrSameAccount, ErrNoAccount, ErrInsufficient) with the debit/credit still done while both accounts are locked, so transfers remain atomic. Made `Bank.Total()` take the same bank-level mutex so it returns a consistent snapshot during concurrent transfers. Verified with `go test -race -count=1 -timeout 60s ./...`, which passes.
